name: tfweflolab
description: TFWefloLab — Testfort Webflow Laboratory. A focused QA workbench for Webflow-built sites: crawler-style audit, deep E2E user-flow tests on .w-form / .w-tabs / .w-dropdown / .w-slider / IX2 / AI components, visual regression, accessibility, SEO, performance. Built on Playwright + axe-core + Lighthouse. Powered by TestFort.

scripts.test:desktop: playwright test --project="Desktop Chrome (Windows 11)" --project="Desktop Firefox (Windows 11)" --project="Desktop Edge (Windows 11)" --project="Desktop Chrome (macOS)" --project="Desktop Safari (macOS)"
scripts.test:mobile: playwright test --project="Mobile Chrome (Android - Pixel 7)" --project="Mobile Safari (iPhone 14)" --project="Mobile Chrome (iOS - iPhone 14)"
scripts.test:tablet: playwright test --project="Tablet Safari (iPad Pro 11)" --project="Tablet Chrome (iPad Pro 11)" --project="Tablet Chrome (Android - Galaxy Tab S4)"
scripts.test:realdevice:mobile: playwright test --config playwright.realdevice.config.js --project="RD iPhone 14" --project="RD Pixel 7" --project="RD Galaxy S9+"
scripts.test:realdevice:tablet: playwright test --config playwright.realdevice.config.js --project="RD iPad Pro 11" --project="RD Galaxy Tab S4"
scripts.test:bs:windows: playwright test --config playwright.browserstack.config.js --project="BS Chromium (Windows 11)" --project="BS Firefox (Windows 11)" --project="BS Chromium (Windows 10)"
scripts.test:bs:macos: playwright test --config playwright.browserstack.config.js --project="BS Chromium (macOS Sonoma)" --project="BS Firefox (macOS Sonoma)" --project="BS Safari / WebKit (macOS Sonoma)" --project="BS Safari / WebKit (macOS Ventura)"
